gloss: to start getting angry; to flare up

definitions.gloss: to start getting angry; to flare up; to lose one's temper
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin to get angry. The {出|だ}す component stresses the abrupt onset — the anger flares up, often set off by something. A compound of {怒|おこ}る (to get angry) and {出|だ}す.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: He flies into a rage over little things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}らなかった→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Apparently he didn't like being warned, because he suddenly flew into a rage.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive. Compound verb: ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧.

NUANCE: The ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ component emphasizes the sudden onset of anger — the person abruptly starts getting angry, usually in reaction to something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}す: to suddenly start getting angry
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}す: to flare up all of a sudden

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧: to start crying
- ⟦{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す→笑い出す：06678_waraidasu⟧: to start laughing
